notes:
Two fixes from a live Assetto Corsa session at the Renault test track.

- The Corners window finds every corner on a track GOAT learns live from your own lap (AC/ACC): one corner per apex with the real left/right arrow, instead of merging a loop or a multi-apex complex into one. A new best lap rebuilds the list.
- The radar is see-through: only the cones, the centre car block, the dashed guide lines and a faint rim remain; the rim turns red when a car is alongside or closing.
